rows.method: Frozen DURA plus input-conditioned per-time 9-tap complex/conjugate FIR correction and waveform residual, trained with source IQ and DURA guard

notes: Original source-only DURA frozen and separately initialized 9-tap time-varying correction trained using source IQ plus DURA-relative guard.
No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target data during training; frozen F only after model freeze.
Initial correction exactly zero; no source or target score selection. All seven Phase1 views run and score truth-last regardless of source results.
The correction has 28614 parameters in addition to the full 266951-parameter frozen DURA and its physical solving cost.
